layout.body:
Learn How to Use the Online Catalog
You are cordially invited to attend the upcoming training seminar. It will be held at Conference Room 203 on the second floor of the Luther Library at 2;30 pm this Saturday. Come here to learn how to locate your desired sources in this online catalog. The research software will give you an efficient solution to finding books, magazines, newspapers, and audio-visual materials. We will teach you the important computer skills required to identify and locate them.
If you'd like to attend this course, please make a reservation by calling 232-34442565. Only one hundred seats are available, so rush to preregister now! Don't miss a chance that people have never had before.

questions.analysis: Who probably wrote this notice? 原文依据：地点在 Luther Library，内容是教使用图书馆online catalog（在线目录）。 通知最可能是图书馆工作人员写的。 A：电脑技术员 → 错误 B：技工 → 错误 C：图书馆工作人员 → 正确 D：网购公司 → 错误

questions.stem: What is suggested from the notice?

options.A: This seminar will give you general instructions on how to use computers.
options.B: This seminar will never take place
options.C: This kind of seminar will be held for the first time
options.D: People have never got the catalog
